  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds because the Canadian IP differs from the United States card country and CVV failed. Card is the sole adverse family; all other rule conditions are false. No household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Under §6.6(b), Card required id_check. That check passed, so §5.3(a) now requires clear and prohibits further hold, decline, escalation or needs_check. Travel is the most plausible benign explanation; stolen-card use was initially plausible but is weakened by successful verification. No contact check is required and no further check would change the prescribed disposition."
